method: No OSS DEM twin exists (survey_oss.md): validate the DEM leg against closed-form/literature anchors, layered as (1) closed-form contact restitution/duration/overlap, (2) Stokes-limit settling as a plumbing self-check only, (3) Schiller-Naumann settling vs Clift-Gauvin literature curve, (4) confined-box LBM Cd reported as a non-gating fluid-side health check, (5) momentum-exchange ledger as an exact invariant.
conventions: time step expressed as a fraction of the analytic contact duration t_c (20/40/80/160) for contact arms and of the particle relaxation time tau_p (25/100) for settling arms; buoyancy folded into g_eff=g(1-rho_f/rho_p); references written as standalone functions in the driver, never imported from the code under test
transfer: test whether a model detail (the max(0,.) no-tension clamp in LinearSpringDashpot) biases the physics by running the same solver with a clip=False control model; residual 8.9% at 160 steps/contact vs 0.43% without the clamp
